neighbours.label: planning talk: the actions, goals and things someone will do (what to do, which goals to set)
fire: The new principal asked teachers which goals they want to set for the spring term.
Our team must agree on the steps we will take to cut costs next quarter.
Write down three things you will do this week to improve your sleep.
The board will decide which projects to fund and which actions to delay.
Before the meeting, think about what you need to do to finish the report.
The nurse helped him set goals and plan the actions needed to recover.
Each department should list the tasks it plans to complete by June.
We still have to work out how to reach our targets and who will do what.
quiet: The new principal arrived on a rainy morning in the spring term.
Our team ate lunch together at the small cafe next to the office.
Write down the names of the birds you saw at the lake this week.
The board met in the old hall, which smelled of dust and coffee.
Before the meeting, the room was cold and the lights were dim.
The nurse brought him a blanket and a cup of warm tea.
Each department has a small kitchen and a window facing the park.
We sat on the porch and watched the rain fall over the hills.

notes: Card: weak pole (max 7.4), peaks on ' ways', ' do', ' actions', ' projects', ' needs', ' goal' in plans and to-do talk. Probe: 'which goals to set' 0.36, 'what we will do' 0.13, a river scene 0.02.
